topIssues.title: L1 contracts upgrade to op-contracts/v7.0.0-rc.4 overrides SystemConfig.batchInbox value.
topIssues.author: rado-alchemy
topIssues.body:
<!--
Need help?
Refer to our contributing guidelines for additional information about making a good issue:
https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/.github/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
-->

**Bug Description**
L1 contracts upgrade to op-contracts/v7.0.0-rc.4 overrides `SystemConfigProxy.batchInbox` value. For chains where this value does not follow spec at https://specs.optimism.io/protocol/configurability.html#consensus-parameters this value is incorrect. This impacts chains which used some older versions of `chainIdToBatchInbox(chainId)` where the address was in the form of `0xFF000....00<chainId>`.
Example is OP Sepolia that was recently upgraded. [`batch_inbox_address` value in superchain registry - `0xff00000000000000000000000000000011155420` ](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/blob/main/superchain/configs/sepolia/op.toml#L10) does not match [onchain value - `0x0002b8639730E2F4dc88Dfd5Bbd0352E5518A758`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0x034edD2A225f7f429A63E0f1D2084B9E0A93b538#readProxyContract)

The impact is probably minimal as operators use value from rollup.json or superchain registry, but it is still a source of confusion (and eventual problem in the future if someone decides to use that value from systemConfigProxy).

**Steps to Reproduce**
1. Upgrade a chain that was created earlier with `batch_inbox_address` that starts with `0xFF` (can take existing one and anvil fork mainnet/sepolia)
2. run upgrade against anvil fork (override any safe owners and threshold on anvil)
3. observe systemConfig.batchInbox value - it gets changes (or check transaction logs) 

**Expected behavior**
Preserve existing systemConfig.batchInbox value

**Environment Information:**
op-contracts/v7.0.0-rc.4

topPRs.title: fix: Super ZK game QA fixes
topPRs.author: 0xarktos
topPRs.body:
## Summary

QA review fixes for the Super ZK dispute game focusing on natpsec clarifications, a formatting consistency fix, and two new tests. No contract behavior changes.

- **`ZKDisputeGame` natspec:** describe it as a super-roots / interop-ready game, correct the `ClaimData` slot-packing comments, renumber the CWIA immutable-arg enumeration after `l2ChainId` was removed, and clarify the `resolve()` challenger-wins branch (prove deadline expired). Patch semver bump `2.0.0` → `2.0.1`.
- **`LibGameArgs.decodeZK`:** use a consistent decimal offset in the assembly block.
- **Tests:**
  - Round-trip test asserting `OPContractsManagerUtils.makeGameArgs` output decodes back through `LibGameArgs.decodeZK` field-for-field.
  - LibClone length-overflow regression test: factory `create` with oversized extra data must revert for both ZK and super fault games — guards against the Solady CWIA clone-corruption bug if the library version changes. See H-1 in the [past audit](https://cantina.xyz/portfolio/018cf146-6e36-49a9-82b3-9ae39904f95a) for details.

## Test plan
```bash
DEV_FEATURE__ZK_DISPUTE_GAME=true forge test --match-contract "DisputeGameFactory_Create_ZkDisputeGame_Test|OPContractsManagerUtils_MakeGameArgs_Test"
```

topPRs.title: proofs: update clock and air gap defaults
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
Updates the proof-game timing defaults to keep the optimistic withdrawal path at 7 days while reducing the portal and dispute-game finality air gaps to 12 hours each.

What changed:

- Set `PROOF_MATURITY_DELAY_SECONDS` defaults to 12 hours.
- Set `DISPUTE_GAME_FINALITY_DELAY_SECONDS` defaults to 12 hours.
- Increased standard dispute-game max clock duration to 6.5 days.
- Updated contracts-bedrock deploy config defaults, OPCM verification defaults, and standard validator expectations.
- Updated op-deployer defaults so generated deploy configs use the same timing values.
- Updated interopgen devnet max-clock wiring and op-validator messages that mention the expected max clock duration.

Note: this intentionally does not update superchain-registry standard params. Those values are owned by the SuperchainRegistry submodule and will be updated separately

Tests were updated for the constants changes and run with:

- `forge test --match-path 'test/opcm/Deploy*.t.sol'`
- `forge test --match-path test/scripts/VerifyOPCM.t.sol`
- `go test ./op-chain-ops/interopgen ./op-validator/pkg/validations`
- `RUST_JIT_BUILD=1 go test -count=1 -timeout 30m -run '^TestInteropSystemNoop$' ./op-acceptance-tests/tests/interop/smoke/`

fixes https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20774
